name: CellTrack
description: A benchmark dataset of 2D microscopy sequences with annotations for evaluating cell tracking algorithms.
evaluation_method: TRA and SEG (tracking accuracy and segmentation metrics); often reported with F1 and IoU for detection/segmentation
reputation: Well-known within the bioimage-analysis / cell-tracking community as a curated microscopy benchmark, though less prominent than large community challenges.
notes: Specialized microscopy dataset (non-LLM). Performance varies by imaging modality and annotation quality; moderate dataset size and potential annotation variability across sequences.
